note: Logical 4-layer classification shared by all characters. Layers are categories, not draw order: the actual stacking is each part's zOrder plus occlusion data (e.g. back hair or the rear robe can be drawn behind the body while belonging to L3). zOrderBand is only the default range for new parts.

layers.label: Layer 0 BASE_BODY

bodyGuidePolicy.minor: minor_neutral_structure (neutral mannequin-like structure guide, no anatomical detail)

measurementStatus.VERIFIED: measured and verified (automated measurement or human-confirmed)
measurementStatus.ESTIMATED: inferred from nearby visible evidence or measured by AI visual inspection without human confirmation
measurementStatus.UNKNOWN: cannot be measured (e.g. hidden by costume)
measurementStatus.TEMPLATE: studio template placeholder; never a measurement
measurementStatus.DESIGNED_CANDIDATE: newly designed value proposed for a master body; never a canon measurement

note2: measurementStatus is independent of approvalStatus (UNAPPROVED_* / DIRECTOR_APPROVED / CANONICAL_PROTECTED ...).
